welcome.title: For dua, there are times when the doors open
welcome.body: Ijaba alerts you at those times — the last third of the night, the Friday hour, between adhan and iqama. And you choose which ones reach you.

location.title: Where are you?
location.subtitle: Prayer times are calculated on your device — never sent to a server.
location.manual_hint: For travel, or if you'd rather not share your location

permissions.title: So the alert reaches you
permissions.body: Three steps. The third is the one everyone forgets — without it, your phone stops alerts while you sleep.
permissions.notifications_hint: A normal permission the system asks for once.
permissions.exact_alarms_hint: Not asked automatically — we open the setting for you.
permissions.battery_hint_brand: A {brand} setting the system never mentions. Without it, the phone stops the alert while you sleep.
permissions.battery_hint_generic: Some phones stop apps in the background. Let Ijaba run so alerts arrive.
permissions.later: I'll do it later — alerts may not arrive

methods.france: Union of Islamic Organisations of France
methods.russia: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia
methods.tehran: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran

alert_control.title: Windows of response
alert_control.subtitle: Choose only what should reach you. The rest stays silent.
alert_control.footer: Every window you turn off frees a scheduled alert — so only what matters reaches you.

dua.tasbih_complete: Count complete — may Allah increase you from His bounty

settings.title: Settings
settings.adjustment_hint: Move any adhan by a few minutes to match your mosque or the official calendar. Alerts follow the adjusted time.
settings.about_body: Ijaba alerts you at the times when dua is most hoped to be accepted. Prayer times are calculated on your device; your location is never sent to a server.
settings.about_sources: Duas are from the Quran and the authentic Sunnah; each one shows its source.
settings.iqama_hint: These vary by mosque: when the iqama comes after the adhan, how long the prayer takes, and how long the after-prayer window stays open.

dua_preview.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
dua_preview.meaning: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
dua_preview.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul afwa fa'fu anni

mine.title: My duas
mine.hint: They show after the sourced duas at the times you choose, so they're there when an alert comes. They stay on your phone.
mine.empty: You haven't written your own dua yet
mine.empty_hint: Write what's in your heart — Allah knows your secrets and your private words.

greeting.after_asr: Good evening — time for the evening adhkar

home_warm.reminder_label: A reminder · new each time you open the app
home_warm.etiquette_title: Do you know the etiquette of dua?
home_warm.etiquette_subtitle: {count} manners from the Prophet's ﷺ guidance that bring you closer to an answer
home_warm.welcome_body: We ask Allah to make this app a means to an answered dua for you and those you love.

reminders.near_meaning: And when My servants ask you about Me — I am near.
reminders.call_meaning: And your Lord says: Call upon Me; I will answer you.
reminders.humbly_meaning: Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret.

completion.title: May Allah accept it from you
completion.verse_meaning: Our Lord, accept from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
completion.hadith: “The deeds most loved by Allah are the most constant, even if few.” — al-Bukhari and Muslim
completion.share: Share Ijaba with those you love — whoever guides to good is like the one who does it
completion.share_text: Ijaba — an app that reminds you of the times dua is answered: the last third of the night, between adhan and iqama, and the Friday hour.

etiquette.title: The etiquette of dua
etiquette.subtitle: From the Prophet's ﷺ guidance — for a dua closer to an answer
etiquette.hero_meaning: And your Lord says: Call upon Me; I will answer you.
etiquette.praise_title: Begin with praise and blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
etiquette.praise_body: Praise Allah and extol Him, then send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ, then ask for whatever you wish.
etiquette.certain_title: Call on Him certain of an answer
etiquette.certain_body: “Call upon Allah while certain of being answered.”
etiquette.resolve_body: Don't say “O Allah, forgive me if You will” — ask with certainty, for no one can compel Allah.
etiquette.hands_body: “Your Lord is Modest and Generous: He is too modest to turn back empty the hands His servant raises to Him.”
etiquette.repeat_body: When the Prophet ﷺ made dua he made it three times, and when he asked he asked three times.
etiquette.others_title: Pray for others in their absence
etiquette.others_body: The angel appointed to you says: “Amin, and the same for you.”
etiquette.times_title: Seek out the times of answer
etiquette.times_body: The last third of the night, between adhan and iqama, and the Friday hour — and Ijaba reminds you of them.
etiquette.haste_body: “You are answered as long as you are not impatient, saying: I prayed and was not answered.”
etiquette.sin_title: Praying for sin or cutting family ties
etiquette.sin_body: “A servant keeps being answered as long as he does not pray for sin or for cutting family ties.”
etiquette.against_title: Praying against yourself or your family
etiquette.against_body: “Do not pray against yourselves, your children or your wealth.”
etiquette.kept_body: “No Muslim makes a dua with no sin or cutting of family ties in it but Allah gives him one of three: He answers it soon, or saves it for him in the Hereafter, or turns away from him an equal harm.”
etiquette.verify: Sources to be reviewed before release

warm_alerts.last_third_body: Our Lord descends to the lowest heaven and says: Who calls on Me, that I may answer him? — What would you like to ask Him tonight?
warm_alerts.friday_title: The hour of response this Friday
warm_alerts.friday_body: The last hour before Maghrib — an hour when acceptance is hoped for, so don't miss it.
warm_alerts.morning_body: Your morning adhkar await — a few minutes that guard your day, by Allah's leave.

week.line_mid: “The deeds most loved by Allah are the most constant, even if few.”
week.line_full: A full week — may Allah accept it from you and increase you from His bounty
week.line_saturday: A new week, a new page — begin it with a dua

days.title: Your days with Ijaba
